title: Construction of the exterior dual determinant pairing
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, $M^\vee=\mathcal Hom(M,\mathcal O_X)$ its internal dual [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and $n\geq0$. For the sheafified exterior powers and wedges of local sections [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there exists a morphism $f:\bigwedge^n M^\vee\to(\bigwedge^n M)^\vee$. For every open $U$, every $a_i\in M(U)$ and $\varphi_j\in M^\vee(U)$, its value on $\varphi_1\wedge\cdots\wedge\varphi_n$, evaluated on $a_1\wedge\cdots\wedge a_n$, is $\det(\varphi_j(a_i))$. No local freeness assumption is needed.

proof.text: For each tuple of internal dual sections on U, evaluate on every subopen V and apply the canonical exterior-power determinant pairing. Its value on pure wedges is the determinant of evaluations. The determinant formula is natural under restriction: internal Hom sections commute with restriction, and ring restriction preserves the finite determinant polynomial.

By the exterior universal property, these functionals give a morphism from the exterior presheaf on the localized open site to the structure sheaf there. Extend to the exterior sheaf by the module sheafification adjunction. Uniqueness makes these extensions commute when U shrinks. Thus the alternating multilinear pairing of the dual tuple has values in the internal dual of the exterior sheaf.

Apply the exterior universal property in the dual tuple and extend the resulting presheaf morphism through sheafification, its target being a sheaf. The two adjunction units recover the determinant formula on wedges. The construction uses no basis or rank, and includes the empty determinant.

theorem exterior_dual_pairing_exists (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f :
    (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf (Scheme.Modules.dual M) n) ⟶
      Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf M n),
    ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U))
      (φ : Fin n → (Scheme.Modules.dual M).val.obj (op U)),
      (f.val.app (op U) (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection
        (Scheme.Modules.dual M) n U φ)).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
        (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection M n U a) =
      (Matrix.of fun i j ↦
        (show X.presheaf.obj (op U) from
          (φ j).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (a i))).det
